title: First transformer
change: iTransformer on daily weather + satellite data over each crop's full season (incl. the autumn before for winter crops), with wet/frost indicators and satellite data averaged over farmland only
lesson: Averaging satellite data over farmland only helped (67 of 100 crop-years, confirmed); the full season and the extra indicators were not confirmed but were kept with it by the old count rule.

title: Longer history, observed growth stages, national signal
change: Training data from 2000 instead of 2003, DWD-observed growth-stage dates, a national-level component
lesson: None of the three ideas was confirmed. The 2000-2025 data stayed as the basis for later versions.

title: Harvest date, crop-stage weather, district anomalies
change: Observed harvest date; weather summarised per growth stage; each district's deviation from its normal
lesson: No single change was confirmed; all three were kept together by the old count rule (65 of 100 crop-years), which was later found to be a flawed way to choose.

title: Trend rule + one fine-tuned model per crop
change: A fairer long-term trend for the starting point; the shared model is fine-tuned separately for each crop
lesson: Neither change was confirmed; both were kept by the old count rule (68 of 100). Won 12 of 18 paper comparisons. Main model until v12.

title: National gate, separate autumn/spring models
change: Switch to a national-level forecast where it looked safer; split autumn- and spring-sown crops
lesson: Neither confirmed; district forecasts got worse (MAPE 12.59 vs 12.24).

title: Stricter scoring rules (no model)
change: One fixed accuracy score, 2010-2015 kept as an untouched test, adoption only with >= 95% certainty
lesson: From here on every version is judged the same way.

title: Recent yields as input
change: The model sees the last few years' yields of the district
lesson: Better on average, but only 87% certain (rule needs 95%).

title: Rapeseed flowering index
change: Satellite 'yellowness' during rapeseed flowering
lesson: Rapeseed better on average in the clean test, but only 83% certain; all crops together slightly worse.

title: Blended baseline
change: Mix of the 5-year and long-term average as the starting point
lesson: Better on average, but only 84% certain.

title: Corrected data foundation
change: Four data changes at once: yields matched by official district code (fixes 18 city/county mix-ups), ERA5 weather for all districts, district-own trend reference, corrected satellite dates
lesson: Worse; with four changes at once the cause was unclear, so v11 tested each.

title: Which v10 change hurt? (diagnostic)
change: Undo each v10 change one at a time
lesson: ERA5 weather everywhere (-0.042 skill) and the added/corrected district series (-0.030) hurt; the trend reference and satellite dates made no difference.

title: Corrected yields + station weather + reliable series
change: Correct district matching, DWD stations first (ERA5 only for gaps), train only on well-reported series
lesson: Exact tie with v4, so the 95% rule was not met; used as the base from v13 on because its data is correct and it covers ~80 more districts.

title: Crop-specific satellite averaging
change: Satellite data averaged over each crop's own fields (EU crop map) instead of all farmland
lesson: Satellite pixels (250 m) are bigger than fields: adds noise, not information.

title: DWD HYRAS 1 km gridded weather
change: Official DWD 1 km weather grid (built from ~2,000 stations) averaged over each district's farmland
lesson: Better weather data (rain r 0.94 vs 0.68 for ERA5) but no better forecasts, not even in districts without their own station (88.44 vs 88.47); 24% certain.

title: Area-weighted training
change: Training gives districts that grow more of a crop more weight (sqrt of census crop area), so noisy small-area statistics count less
lesson: No net gain: better for wheat and winter barley, worse for oats and summer barley; but 12/18 papers.

title: YieldFormer-DE-i: iTransformer + district error memory
change: Each forecast is corrected by part of the district's own forecast error in the previous 1-3 years (the size of the correction is learned from earlier years only); no retraining
lesson: First change to pass the strict rule (98.4% certain). Fixes the model's lagging district normals: 2016-2025 accuracy 88.38% vs 87.90%.

title: Checks and forecasts
change: Is the transformer needed (versions without the network), doubtful official figures, 90% ranges, the 2025 wheat miss; frozen forecasts for 2026 and 2027
lesson: Without the network accuracy drops 1-2 points; doubtful figures change < 0.1 point; the 2025 wheat miss came from the network over-reading a dry spring.

title: YieldFormer-DE-T and -P: TFT and PatchTST
change: The other two transformers (Temporal Fusion Transformer, PatchTST) on exactly the same data, years and fine-tuning, each with the error memory
lesson: TFT more accurate (88.76% vs 88.48%; 88.91% on 2016-2025) but only 66% certain on 2010-2015; PatchTST weaker.

title: YieldFormer-DE: ensemble of -i, -T and -P
change: Average of the three transformers (iTransformer, TFT, PatchTST), equal weights fixed in advance, plus the district error memory
lesson: Passes the rule (96.7% certain) and wins 13 of 16 years; steadier than any single network. Not past the stricter multiple-testing bar (99.6%).

title: Swing and range calibration
change: Scale up the forecast's national good/bad-year swing; recalibrate the 80% ranges
lesson: Scaling the swing also scales wrong signals (64% certain, worse on 2016-2025); recalibrated ranges overshot (85% coverage instead of 80%).

title: Crop stress inputs; forecasts during the season
change: Heat, drought and frost indicators at the critical crop stages for all three networks; forecasts with data cut at 30 June and 31 July
lesson: Only 56% certain: helps TFT and PatchTST, hurts the iTransformer. In season: no better than the 5-year average at 30 June, +1.1 points at 31 July.
